title: MAGIC ENGLISH BEGINNER — WORLD 3: STORIES, QUESTIONS & DISCOVERY
description: A high-density beginner world that moves from isolated sentences into connected English through stories, questions, descriptions, nature, community and independent communication.

missions.title: Question Power
speaking: Answer who, what, where and when questions.
listening: Identify the question word you hear.
Listen and choose the correct answer.

missions.title: My Favorite Things
speaking: Give a simple reason for each choice.
grammar: I like cats because they are cute.

missions.title: Big and Small World
speaking: Describe a person, animal and object.
Say two things that are different.
listening: Identify an object from three adjectives.

missions.title: My Room, My World
listening: Listen to a room description and locate objects.
grammar: The lamp is on the desk.
The toy is under the bed.

missions.title: Story Time: The Lost Ball
speaking: Say what happened first, then and finally.
listening: Understand a short story about a lost ball.
reading: Read a 70–90 word illustrated-style beginner story.

missions.title: Nature Explorer
speaking: Describe what you can see in nature.
listening: Identify nature words from a description.
Listen for where an animal is.
grammar: A bird is in the tree.

missions.title: At the Library
speaking: Say what kind of story you like.
listening: Identify book, shelf and request details.

missions.title: Around the City
grammar: The park is next to the library.
The shop is across from the school.

missions.title: Conversation Mission: Meet a New Friend
speaking: Ask eight questions to a new friend.
Answer eight questions in complete simple sentences.
listening: Identify name, age, school, family, hobby and favorite things.
reading: Read a short profile and answer questions.
writing: Write a simple profile about yourself.
grammar: Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
missions.challenge: Hold a guided beginner conversation using English questions and answers only.

missions.title: My Body and Healthy Habits
speaking: Explain a simple morning health routine.

missions.title: Animal Homes
grammar: A bird lives in a nest.
A bear lives in a forest.

missions.title: Magic Kitchen
grammar: Put the apple in the bowl.

missions.title: Weekend Adventure
speaking: Tell what you do in the morning, afternoon and evening.

missions.title: Weather Reporter
speaking: Say what clothes you need for the weather.

missions.title: Problem Solver
speaking: Ask the right person for help.
listening: Identify the problem and the requested help.

missions.title: Picture to Story
speaking: Describe a picture in five sentences.
Build a story using first, next, then and finally.
listening: Listen to a story and match it to pictures.
writing: Write 6–8 sentences from a picture sequence.

missions.title: Reading Explorer
speaking: Tell the beginning, middle and end of a story.
listening: Listen to a short passage and identify the main idea.
reading: Answer who, what, where, when and why questions.
writing: Write three sentences about the story.

missions.title: English-Only Challenge
speaking: Describe a person, place and activity.
listening: Understand natural but clear beginner-speed questions.
Respond to short instructions without translating every word.
reading: Read short connected sentences and infer meaning from context.

missions.title: WORLD 3 MASTER QUEST — STORY & DISCOVERY
speaking: Introduce yourself and ask a new friend eight questions.
Describe a place in your city.
Explain a simple problem and ask for help.
Retell a short story in sequence.
listening: Understand a 90-second A1 conversation or story.
Identify main idea, people, place, time, actions and key details.
reading: Read a 160–200 word A1 text and answer comprehension questions.
writing: Write 10–12 connected sentences about a person, place or day.
missions.challenge: Complete an English-only multi-skill quest: listen, answer, ask, read, retell and write using connected English.
missions.mastery_target: Learner can sustain short beginner conversations, understand simple connected stories, ask and answer common questions, describe familiar environments, and produce connected A1-level sentences.

world_review.mastery: Learner moves from isolated beginner sentences toward connected A1 communication, simple storytelling, comprehension and independent everyday English.
